rationale: Only 3 Southeast Asian countries host >=1,000 Myanmar refugees (Bangladesh/India are South Asia): Thailand (~90,000 in 9 border camps + Thai FM met Min Aung Hlaing April 2026), Malaysia (~190,000 UNHCR-registered), and Indonesia (~3,500-4,500 Rohingya in Aceh). Thailand has the land border, established camp administration, and bilateral repatriation framework history. Virtually exhaustive top 5 -> sum=0.98.
